analysis_finding_references_contradictio.where: "analysis_finding_references"."contradiction_id" is not null and "analysis_finding_references"."metric_id" is not null

analysis_finding_references_gap_metric_u.where: "analysis_finding_references"."evidence_gap_id" is not null and "analysis_finding_references"."metric_id" is not null

analysis_runs_required_text_check.name: analysis_runs_required_text_check
analysis_runs_required_text_check.value:
length(btrim("analysis_runs"."module")) > 0
    and length(btrim("analysis_runs"."run_type")) > 0
    and length(btrim("analysis_runs"."input_projection_version")) > 0
    and length(btrim("analysis_runs"."input_hash")) > 0
    and length(btrim("analysis_runs"."prompt_version")) > 0
    and length(btrim("analysis_runs"."provider")) > 0
    and length(btrim("analysis_runs"."model_identifier")) > 0

analysis_runs_completion_check.name: analysis_runs_completion_check
analysis_runs_completion_check.value:
("analysis_runs"."status" = 'RUNNING' and "analysis_runs"."completed_at" is null)
    or ("analysis_runs"."status" in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') and "analysis_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

evidence_period_check.name: evidence_period_check
evidence_period_check.value: "evidence"."period_end" is null or "evidence"."period_start" is null or "evidence"."period_end" >= "evidence"."period_start"

metrics_period_check.name: metrics_period_check
metrics_period_check.value: "metrics"."period_end" is null or "metrics"."period_start" is null or "metrics"."period_end" >= "metrics"."period_start"

proposal_reviews_corrected_payload_check.name: proposal_reviews_corrected_payload_check
proposal_reviews_corrected_payload_check.value:
("proposal_reviews"."decision" = 'CORRECTED' and "proposal_reviews"."reviewed_payload" is not null)
    or ("proposal_reviews"."decision" <> 'CORRECTED' and "proposal_reviews"."reviewed_payload" is null)

proposal_reviews_noncanonical_decision_c.name: proposal_reviews_noncanonical_decision_check
proposal_reviews_noncanonical_decision_c.value:
"proposal_reviews"."decision" not in ('REJECTED', 'UNRESOLVED')
    or ("proposal_reviews"."canonical_entity_type" is null and "proposal_reviews"."canonical_entity_id" is null)
